title: The Mirari's Disastrous Journey
summary: The Mirari leaves the Cabal, corrupts leaders of the Order and the merfolk empire, and returns after widespread ruin.
narrative: Lieutenant Kirtar of the Order acquired the artifact after the attack on Cabal City; his use of it led to catastrophe for the Order.

The cephalid emperor Aboshan later attempted to fulfill his dreams through the Mirari, unleashing devastating flooding. Laquatus continued his maneuvering, and the sphere ultimately returned to Cabal custody.
